main_text.p: rum & vitæ in eos qui non comparerent, in loco habita‐tionis suæ. Sed cum nuncium accepisset de Clade qua Comes Arembergensis, & Hispani VVinschoti in Frisia affecti erant, gravi ira ac dolore commotus præcipitari captivorum processum mandavit, condemnatoque sententia Kalendis Iunij Bruxellæ in foro equino capitis supplicio affecit Dominos ac Nobiles qui sequuntur.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. Show-through text in the lower half of the page is not transcribed. The catchword "Quo" is partly illegible and is given with doubt.
